dedupe_keys.name: lands department open geospatial data of hong kong orthophotos aerial photos 3d map dtm

description: The Lands Department of Hong Kong publishes its geospatial open data through the Common Spatial Data Infrastructure (CSDI) Portal and DATA.GOV.HK. The open data page lists digital orthophotos in GeoTIFF, digital aerial photos (the L0 version as 300 dpi JPEG files of about 2 to 3 MB, covering the whole territory at various flying heights over different years), an aerial photo flight index in XLS, KML and KMZ, SatRef real-time GNSS streams, a database of about 5,500 geodetic control stations, the 3D Digital Map launched territory-wide in March 2025, a 3D pedestrian network, 3D spatial data of buildings, infrastructure and terrain, a 5-metre digital terrain model with an accuracy of plus or minus 5 metres that includes elevated roads and bridges, the i-Series digital topographic and land boundary maps, street names, and historical material such as old maps, about 72,000 old survey sheets from 1920 onwards and old photos. Access is free under the DATA.GOV.HK terms and conditions; no open licence is named on the page read. Caveats: the old survey sheets are geo-referenced for general reference only, and the DTM shows vegetation height where land is covered by vegetation. Coverage is Hong Kong. It supports digital twins and hazard exposure analysis of roads, bridges, buildings and slopes, such as landslide and flood terrain work; related records are the IGN LiDAR HD point clouds and the CNIG download centre of Spain, and the Hong Kong Planning Department open data is catalogued by another piece.
